top_signals.title: Welcome to the New Era of Bond Yields at 5%
top_signals.summary: Treasury yields are surging past 5%, threatening to push up borrowing costs on everything from mortgages and car loans to credit cards. Ruth Carson explains why the impact is being felt far beyond Wall Street and the US. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Paraguay Is Increasing Beef Exports to US, President Peña Says
top_signals.summary: Paraguay is sending more beef to the US, but it hasn’t been allocated an export quota like the Trump administration set for Argentina, President Santiago Peña said in a Bloomberg Television interview Friday in New York.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Microsoft packages business AI in single app as it tries to compete with Anthropic
top_signals.summary: With Microsoft still searching for a winning AI strategy, the company its updating its Copilot app to combine more capabilities.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Doubts grow over claims OpenAI agent hacked Australian Medicare portal
top_signals.summary: Researchers are questioning whether an OpenAI agent needed to hack an Australian government health portal to access it, after a review of the website’s archived code found it explicitly directed visitors to an unauthenticated endpoint.
